conditions.text: All six steps above were present in every one of the 3 events considered (support 1.0), so treat the sequence as the required path.
Preconditions to set up, each seen in all events: app version 1.2.0, iOS 18.4, device iPhone15,2, and the new_push_flow flag turned on.

Conditions that vary across events and therefore are not required: push.deliverable was false in 2 events and true in 1; push.os_permission was ALLOWED in 2 and DENIED in 1; push.provider_registration was REGISTERED in 2 and STALE in 1; profile.consistent was false in 2 and true in 1.
Commit ce50197 "MEI-3: Refresh push token on resume" touches the same file as the culprit frame and is a lead worth checking, not a confirmed cause.

missing_evidence_questions.text: What makes the object read at src/modules/push/registration.ts:42 undefined in refreshToken - is it the response body of the 401 POST /api/push/register, or some cached state?
Why does the register call return 401 on resume: is the session/auth token expired or cleared while backgrounded?
Does the crash still reproduce with flag.new_push_flow off, or on other app versions, OS versions and devices - only 1.2.0 / iOS 18.4 / iPhone15,2 appear in these events?
Since permission, deliverability, provider registration and profile consistency all differ between events, which values (if any) change the outcome, and do any of them matter at all?
Did the crash start appearing only after commit ce50197 landed, and what did that commit change at or around line 42?
Are 3 events enough to trust this path, or are there other events of the same incident with different step sequences?

steps_prose.text: Send the app to the background.
Bring the app back to the foreground (resume).
The app issues POST /api/push/register, which comes back 401, and the crash surfaces as a TypeError in refreshToken at src/modules/push/registration.ts line 42.

summary.text: A TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'token')" is thrown in refreshToken at src/modules/push/registration.ts:42 when a user resumes the app and enables push notifications from settings, with the push registration call returning 401; the packet is based on 3 events.
